segments.TIT.1.1-3: Paul introduces himself as God’s servant and apostle
segments.TIT.1.4-4: Paul greets Titus, his true child in the faith
segments.TIT.1.5-5: Paul left Titus in Crete to appoint elders
segments.TIT.1.6-7: Elders must be blameless in family and character
segments.TIT.1.8-9: Elders must live well and hold to the true message
segments.TIT.1.10-11: Rebellious people who mislead households must be silenced
segments.TIT.1.12-13: Titus must firmly correct false teachers
segments.TIT.1.14-14: Do not follow myths or commands of men
segments.TIT.1.15-16: Some say they know God but their actions deny him
segments.TIT.2.1-2: Titus teaches older men to live with self-control
segments.TIT.2.3-5: Older women are to teach the younger women
segments.TIT.2.9-10: Slaves are to be respectful and honest to their masters
segments.TIT.2.11-13: God’s grace teaches us to live well as we wait for Christ
segments.TIT.2.14-14: Christ gave himself to make a people for himself
segments.TIT.3.1-2: Believers should obey rulers and be gentle to everyone
segments.TIT.3.3-3: Before, we were foolish and slaves to our desires
segments.TIT.3.4-5: God saved us because of his mercy, not our deeds
segments.TIT.3.6-7: God poured out the Spirit so we have hope of eternal life
segments.TIT.3.8-8: Believers should be devoted to doing good
segments.TIT.3.9-11: Avoid foolish arguments and reject a divisive person
segments.TIT.3.12-13: Paul asks Titus to come and to help Zenas and Apollos
segments.TIT.3.14-14: Believers must work to meet urgent needs
